sn17.23:1.3: Saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekaputtakaṃ piyam manāpaṃ evam sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya || ||
sn17.23:1.4: Tādiso tāta bhavāhi yādiso Citto ca gahapati Hatthako ca āḷavako ti || || 4
sn17.23:1.5: Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ yad idam Citto gahapati Hatthako ca āḷavako || || 5
sn17.23:1.6: Sace kho tvam tāta agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajasi ||
sn17.23:1.7: tādiso tāta bhavāhi yādiso Sāriputta-Moggalānā ti || || 6
sn17.23:1.8: Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamānaṃ mama sāvakānam bhikkhūnaṃ yadidaṃ Sāriputta-Moggalānā || || 7
sn17.23:1.9: Mā ca kho tvaṃ tāta sekham appamattamānasam lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātūti || ||
sn17.23:1.10: Taṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ sekham appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārāsiloko anupāpuṇāti || so tassa hoti antarāyāya || || 8
sn17.23:1.11: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 9
